A SMALL PLAN, NOT A PERFECT ONE

Make the first step obvious.

One action per line. Start with a verb: choose, open, find, write. You can change these later.

BEFORE YOU STEP AWAY

Leave a breadcrumb for yourself.

A tiny note now can make returning less confusing. Your timer will pause.

Make this space work for you.

Your browser's text zoom and reduced-motion preferences are respected. All actions work with a keyboard.

A WORKSPACE THAT EXPECTS INTERRUPTIONS

Small steps. A saved place.

  1. Make a small plan. Write a few concrete actions, not a giant list of ambitions.
  2. Focus on one step. The rest of the plan is still there when you need it.
  3. Save your place before leaving. Write what you were doing and one exact action to return to.
  4. Come back without a guilt trip. Your breadcrumb waits, even after a reload.

Keyboard: N new plan, F focus current step, Esc leave focus. Shortcuts are inactive while typing or using a dialog. The timer is optional and never auto-completes work.
